source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 488 applies native titlebar appearance to the standalone-window toolbox pseudo-element so it does not suppress the chrome/content separator. Current macOS main/compose styles use transparent toolboxes and a positioned ::after decoration under the native-theme preference. The current preference syntax/name changed; do not restore the removed unified-toolbar appearance from474. Numeric z-index values belong to this stack, not a global style rule.
title: Put native titlebar tint on its decorative pseudo-element
